name: The Game of Death
source:
I took revenge, turned myself in, and didn’t resist. They sentenced me to death. But this prison has its own rules – death row isn’t the end.

Every year, a violent spectacle is held, where prisoners can fight for their freedom. It’s voluntary, open to all – and nearly impossible to win.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
我大仇得报，主动自首，没有做任何反抗。他们判了我死刑。但这所监狱有着自己的规矩——死囚牢房并非终点。

每年这里都会举办一场血腥残酷的生死盛典，囚犯们可以为重获自由而战。这场厮杀全凭自愿、向所有人开放——却几乎无人能够胜出。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
